cap_confirmation: driver state resolved Sableye (offset 0) at L52, Kommo-o (+1) at L53, Hydreigon (+2) at L54, Whimsicott (+1) at L53 = cap 54 + offset - 2 on Medium. Cap window 48-60; C30 (Weather Institute) is done so 54 is live, Badge06 (60) is not yet earned.

attempts.why: No Fairy, Psychic or Ice-special answer to Kommo-o. It reached +4 Defence behind Bulletproof and Body Press OHKOed Mega Metagross (167), Regieleki (167) and Mamoswine (200) in consecutive turns.

Rebuilt to carry the dossier's own crack: Fairy pressure. Spore on Kommo-o turn 1, Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice turn 2 removed the sleeping +2 Kommo-o (4x) outright and put Sableye to 21; Hyper Voice then removed Hydreigon (4x), Sableye and Whimsicott.

strategy_checks.check: Sableye Mega Evolves and the post-Mega ability matters
strategy_checks.evidence: a1 turn 1 and a2 turn 1: Mega Evolution resolves before any move; Magic Bounce is live from then on, and Prankster is gone.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Sableye uses its Prankster action or Recover to stay alive
strategy_checks.evidence: It Megas on turn 1 in both attempts, so Will-O-Wisp (a1 turn 2, burned Amoonguss; a2 turn 4) is never at priority, and Recover was never chosen at 35/183 or 21/183. Both refusals are defensible - Meteor Mash 148 and Hyper Voice 162 both outrun a 91 HP heal - but the authored 'pre-Mega turn is the window' idea never actually happened.

strategy_checks.check: Kommo-o stacks Iron Defense behind Bulletproof and converts with Body Press
strategy_checks.evidence: a1 turns 1-4 reached +4 Defence; Body Press then OHKOed Mega Metagross (turn 5), Regieleki (turn 6) and Mamoswine (turn 7), and was correctly resisted into Zapdos.

strategy_checks.check: Whimsicott passes Tailwind at Prankster priority
strategy_checks.evidence: a2 turn 4: Tailwind set on the opponent side the turn it entered. Encore and Helping Hand were never needed.
a1 Draco Meteor turns 6/8/9 and a2 Fire Blast turn 3 (128 into Amoonguss, super effective).

strategy_checks.check: Alternate deployment (Whimsicott support for Hydreigon) actually pairs
strategy_checks.evidence: Whimsicott is the last reserve in both runs and never shared the field with Hydreigon.

protect_summary: 4 opponent Protects across both attempts, 4 with a concrete payoff, 0 empty, no repetitive guarding.
level_change_rationale: Keep. Attempt 1 was a 6-2 loss to an honest competitive six, and attempt 2 only won cleanly because the party was rebuilt around the dossier's own stated crack (Fairy pressure plus special damage). That is the counterplay working, not an undertuned team. Neither the +1 rule (this was not a first-try win) nor the -1 rule (fewer than three losses) applies.
cooler: Keep the concept - two Pranksters with different jobs is genuinely distinctive. The one concrete improvement: as played, Sableye Mega Evolves on turn 1 every time, which throws away the Prankster window the dossier itself calls the point of the set. If the intent is that the pre-Mega turn matters, the AI should be nudged to spend turn 1 on priority Will-O-Wisp or Recover and Mega on turn 2; alternatively give Whimsicott the lead slot so the Prankster-support half of the concept is on screen from turn 0.
legality_notes: No legality problem in the authored set. All four members and both held Mega Stones are inside the cap-54 window.
